absorptions.upstream_title: Preserve output from hooks that exit before reading stdin (#35194)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: The local hook runner now treats only stdin BrokenPipe as compatible with a child that already exited, preserving captured stdout and the child's exit status. Every other stdin write failure still kills the child and returns an execution error.

behavioral_evidence.assertion: A fast hook preserves completed stdout while a one-megabyte stdin write observes BrokenPipe.
The full hooks package retains its existing execution and parsing behavior.

non_claims: No byte-for-byte source import is claimed.
Only BrokenPipe is tolerated; other write errors are not reclassified.

absorptions.upstream_title: Use current MCP authority for elicitation reviews (#35205)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: The published local MCP connection manager now owns the exact approval policy, effective permission profile, and reviewer selection used to create or refresh it. Reused elicitation reviewers read that published authority instead of an older active turn, apply Never and granular denials before Guardian routing, and retain the empty-form auto-approval rule under a Disabled permission profile.

behavioral_evidence.assertion: A stale active turn cannot override refreshed Never, Disabled, and AutoReview authority.
Cancellation, supersession, invalid configuration, and frozen-auth refresh behavior remain intact.

non_claims: The local configuration model does not yet implement upstream per-connector configuration-layer reviewer overrides.
The local manager is not the upstream centralized immutable McpRuntime type.
Thread-start refresh invalidation is recorded separately as deferred scope.

absorptions.upstream_title: Refresh MCP runtimes across thread startup (#35204)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: Successful explicit MCP OAuth and silent plugin OAuth now queue the existing best-effort refresh across every loaded local thread before completion is reported. Failed OAuth does not queue a refresh. The local implementation deliberately does not claim the upstream startup-window invalidation contract.

behavioral_evidence.assertion: The best-effort refresh helper attempts every loaded thread and strict planning failures remain visible.

non_claims: No centralized runtime/source epoch was added.
A thread crossing startup publication can still miss an invalidation.
The successful OAuth call sites are compile-checked but do not yet have a dedicated end-to-end refresh assertion.

absorptions.upstream_title: Compact host skill paths under metadata pressure (#35172)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: The local core-skills renderer already computes stable root aliases, emits a skill-roots table, selects the aliased form only when it improves the bounded render, and preserves skill identity and relative paths. This covers the host-rendering behavior without importing the absent ext/skills provider.

behavioral_evidence.assertion: Aliases are selected only when they permit more skills to fit the metadata budget.

non_claims: No equivalence is claimed for upstream ext/skills provider, catalog, fragment, or warning rendering.
The upstream commit was not cherry-picked.

deferrals.upstream_title: Expose executor skills through skill tools (#35184)
deferrals.reason: The local tree has no ext/skills crate, no skills.list or skills.read tools, and no per-step ToolContributor contract carrying selected executor capability roots. Direct transplantation would widen session-global filesystem authority without a precise selection lifetime.
missing_prerequisites: local skill provider, catalog, fragment, and tool ownership boundary
exact package confinement for list, body, and resource reads
bounded and paginated results with stale cursor rejection
zero-authority tests for unselected and stale executor skills
non_claims: Executor skill tools are not exposed locally.
P0 priority is an architecture requirement, not an enablement claim.

deferrals.upstream_title: Enable resource reads for explicit executor skills (#35198)
deferrals.reason: The local tree has no ext/skills crate, no explicit executor-skill selection lifetime, and no resource declaration or package-confinement contract. Resource reads cannot be added safely as a standalone tool patch.
missing_prerequisites: accepted executor skill list and read authority contract
exact package confinement for resource paths

non_claims: No executor resource-read authority is available.
